parsed_json.sql: SELECT activities.activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units FROM activities INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno INNER JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid WHERE target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND activities.standard_units = 'nM' AND activities.standard_type IN ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50') AND activities.standard_value < 50 ORDER BY activities.activity_id ASC LIMIT 200
